profile.address: Lancium Clean Campus, 5502 Spinks Rd, Abilene, Taylor County, TX 79603
profile.reading:
Crusoe's Abilene campus, on the Lancium Clean Campus north of Abilene, Texas, is the first site of the Stargate venture of OpenAI, Oracle and SoftBank. Crusoe began construction in mid 2024. Its first two 100 MW buildings were energized in under a year and serve Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, which runs the systems for OpenAI.

A second phase of six more buildings brings the campus to 1.2 GW and is due for completion by the end of 2026, per Crusoe. On 27 March 2026 Crusoe announced a separate 900 MW campus next door for Microsoft, with two buildings and an on-site power plant, which it says takes the full Abilene site to about 2.1 GW. The first building there is expected to be energized in mid 2027.

The 1.2 GW figure is the campus power capacity stated by Crusoe, not measured IT load. Coordinates are a street-level geocode of Spinks Road, not of the building footprint.
